motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting the Natural Open Space and Wildlife Habitat Management Plan subject to: 1. Removing the pedestrian path from the plan that goes west from the Walmart property and southwest to Autumn Lane, behind backyards between Autumn Lane and East Harvest Lane then ends at Shiloh Way
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting the Natural Open Space and Wildlife Habitat Management Plan subject to: 1. Removing the pedestrian path from the plan that goes west from the Walmart property and southwest to Autumn Lane, behind backyards between Autumn Lane and East Harvest Lane then ends at Shiloh Way. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion. Eagle Mountain City Council Agenda – May 20, 2025 Page 8 of 11 Discussion took place on the removal of the pedestrian path, its implications for Open Space, and future management of the area confirming that the space will continue to stay classified as Open Space. They also considered options for semi-truck parking, including a designated parking lot. AMENDED MOTION: Councilmember Wood moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, adopting the Natural Open Space and Wildlife Habitat Management Plan: 1. Removing from the Plan the pedestrian path that goes west from the Walmart property and southwest to Autumn Lane, behind resident backyards between Autumn Lane and East Harvest Lane then ends at Shiloh Way; and 2. Removing the language concerning semi-truck parking; and 3. Amending the grazing period of goats from “two to seven days” to as needed. Councilmember Wright seconded the motion.
